title: Probes stay responsive under a downstream dependency outage
asA: operator whose downstream dependency has gone slow or unresponsive
iWant: the readiness probe to answer within its declared budget even when a declared dependency is hanging on network calls
soThat: a downstream partial outage does not cause the load balancer to time out the probe and cascade the failure into every replica going unready simultaneously

acceptanceCriteria.description: The readiness probe handler returns a response within the readiness evaluation budget declared in configuration (default 1 second) regardless of the responsiveness of any declared dependency; the handler reads a cached last-known state populated by a background evaluator, never issues a synchronous network round trip to a dep from inside the handler.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a declared readiness dependency's real endpoint is configured to hang indefinitely (a network sink with no responder)
acceptanceCriteria.when: a GET is issued against the readiness path and the response time is measured
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response arrives within the declared readiness evaluation budget (default 1 second) and the response's checks entry for the hanging dependency shows state fail with a checkedAt that reflects the last background evaluation attempt, not the current probe-hit time

acceptanceCriteria.description: The background dep-health evaluator runs on its own cadence, declared in configuration; every declared readiness dependency is evaluated at least once per cadence interval regardless of the state of any other dependency.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the process is running with N declared dependencies including one that hangs and the background evaluator cadence declared as C seconds
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process runs for at least 3 * C seconds and each dependency's checkedAt timestamp is sampled from the readiness body
acceptanceCriteria.then: every non-hanging dependency's checkedAt advances at least twice within the window; the hanging dependency's checkedAt advances or its state transitions to fail with a checkedAt that reflects the evaluator's own attempt time, and no other dependency's evaluation is starved by the hanging one

acceptanceCriteria.description: The liveness probe handler under the same hanging-dependency conditions still returns 200 within a bounded budget (default 250 milliseconds), demonstrating that liveness is decoupled from downstream dep health.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a declared readiness dependency is hanging and the readiness probe is returning 503
acceptanceCriteria.when: a GET is issued against the liveness path and the response time is measured
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response status is 200, the response body's status field is pass, and the response arrives within 250 milliseconds
